verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML screening and monitoring product, so a reporting view of KPIs such as false-positive rate and review workload is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only raw data exports (cases, screening, transactions by date range, plus CSV transaction export) and case filtering. There is no documented dashboard or computed metric for dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift or review workload. Deriving those numbers from raw exports would be a user-side workaround, so it earns no credit.
